name: overnight-regression
about: The overnight regression (docs/decisions/2026-10-19-overnight-regression.md). Someone else's '@jarvis-loop regression tonight' is refused. The approver's schedules R1 for 01:00 (acknowledged to them only); a second ask is refused, one is scheduled at a time. The runner (emulator, gpu, voice) polls through the day and the evening and gets nothing: the set time has not come. At 01:00 the queue has been quiet since the morning, so the runner takes it and runs every lane in the fence: the stand-in scripts/e2e all (a web failure with its screenshot, a mobile pass and skip), scripts/e2e voice (a failure with its reply.wav) and the pipeline scenarios (a failure), then each lane's failures once more: the web test passes on the rerun (flaky), the others fail again. Nothing reaches #loop at night; at 08:30 one report: the totals, flaky apart, the duration, per-lane totals, each failure with its assertion, its screenshot or recording and File it, and the flaky test listed apart without a button. The board's report page shows the flaky section and the recording.
